question: Split — ATK on an eco (Ghost, 0 credits), 2v2 vs full-buy, 7-5, near A Rafters. You and your last teammate have pistols. How do you play the eco 2v2?

options.label: Stick together at close range and take one short A fight as a pair to trade damage into their rifles
options.explication_courte: On an eco your only edge is close-range concentration. Pairing up on one short A fight means any duel is traded and you either steal the round or bank a rifle kill that hurts their economy — the whole point of an eco.

sources_option.citation: On an eco, group at close range where pistols compete with rifles; the goal is to trade damage into the enemy economy

options.label: Split up to grab two separate angles and info across A
options.explication_courte: Two lone pistols on separate angles is the long-range fight full-buys want — they pick you off one at a time and you can't trade. Splitting throws away the only eco advantage you have.

sources_option.citation: Spreading solo on an eco lets rifles win every long-range duel; concentration is the only edge pistols have

options.label: Play a full save — avoid contact and keep your pistols and credits for next round
options.explication_courte: A save guarantees a stronger next buy and is legitimate, but with even 2v2 numbers and a full minute, refusing any fight also concedes the round for free with zero damage to their bank.

sources_option.citation: A save preserves credits for a full buy but concedes the round and does no damage to the enemy economy

options.label: Rush deep into A site fast to try to overwhelm the full-buy defenders
options.explication_courte: Charging pistols into a set full-buy site lets the defenders hold angles with rifles and util and win the trade. A blind eco rush usually loses the round and all your guns for little damage.

sources_option.citation: Rushing into a prepared, buying defense on an eco surrenders the range and util advantage to the holders

explication_longue: Eco rounds are a lesson in EV thinking: a round you probably won't win is still worth the money you deny the enemy. On a full eco (Ghost, 0 credits) in a 2v2 on Split near A Rafters versus full-buys, your one structural advantage is concentration at close range — the only distance where a pistol competes with a rifle. Sticking together for one short A fight is the optimal line: any duel is traded because you're paired, and you either steal the round outright or bank a rifle kill that damages their economy and sets up your next buy. Splitting to two angles is the costly error — two lone pistols at range is exactly the fight rifles want, and they pick you apart without a trade. A full save is genuinely acceptable: it guarantees a stronger next round and disciplined teams do it, but with even numbers and a full minute it also concedes this round for free with no damage dealt, trading upside for certainty. Rushing deep into a set A site is the faute: pistols into prepared rifles and utility is a low-percentage gamble that usually loses everything for nothing. Stay together, pick one close fight, damage their bank.

sources.citation: Economy is a team system; on an eco, group at close range to damage the enemy bank rather than spread, save-solo, or blind-rush
